name: Melt Deal
summary: A cart saver popup whose 10% offer is an ice lolly melting away with the countdown
about: An exit popup for a fashion cart that offers 10% off to stay. A mango ice lolly melts with a one-minute countdown: its wavy top sinks, drops gather, fall and spread a puddle, and the ring turns red near the end. Keeping the cart spreads frost over the lolly, stops the clock and applies the code to the PKR total; if time runs out a smaller 5% refreeze is offered, and leaving tucks the cart into a small pill that brings it back.
how: Watch the lolly melt and the ring count down; the last 15 seconds turn red
Press Keep my cart: frost spreads, crystals pop, the clock stops and 10% comes off the total
Let it run out and the deal melts; Refreeze for 5% off still saves the cart
Press No thanks, the close button or Escape: the popup shrinks into a Cart saved pill
Press the pill to reopen the popup with a fresh countdown
